title: Assessing cardiac function: the first steps

items.question: What assessment of function must every fetal echocardiogram include?
options: A qualitative assessment of systolic and diastolic function
A myocardial performance index for both ventricles
None, unless the heart is structurally abnormal
items.explanation: Every fetal echocardiogram must include a qualitative assessment of systolic and diastolic function.

items.question: When should function be assessed quantitatively?
options: When findings raise concern about cardiac function or output
items.explanation: Quantitative assessment should be performed when findings raise concern about function or output.

items.question: Dysfunction is suspected. What does the initial assessment look for?
options: Fetal hydrops or its component findings
The side of the aortic arch
items.explanation: At initial imaging for suspected dysfunction it is important to assess for fetal hydrops or its component findings.

items.question: What may atrioventricular valve regurgitation on Doppler indicate?
items.explanation: Atrioventricular valve regurgitation on Doppler may indicate systolic dysfunction.

items.question: As diastolic function worsens, what may happen to ventricular filling on the inflow Doppler?
options: The filling time shortens until only one inflow wave is seen
The filling time lengthens and a third wave appears
items.explanation: The fraction of the cycle spent filling may shorten until only one inflow wave is seen.

items.question: The fetus is in a tachyarrhythmia and the venous A-wave is reversed. How reliable is this as a sign of worsening function?
options: Unreliable: the sign cannot be trusted outside sinus rhythm
More reliable than in sinus rhythm
items.explanation: Outside sinus rhythm, venous A-wave reversal is an unreliable indicator of worsening cardiac function.

items.question: Which measurements of systolic function does the guideline list for M-mode?
options: Ventricular shortening fraction and annular plane excursion
Peak velocity across the aortic valve
items.explanation: M-mode is among the tools for systolic function: shortening fraction and annular plane excursion of the tricuspid and mitral valves.

items.question: For a compromised fetus, which Doppler recordings should a comprehensive assessment include?
options: Umbilical artery and middle cerebral artery
items.explanation: Pulsed-wave Doppler of the umbilical and middle cerebral arteries should be included, at either the obstetric or the cardiac study.
